kinds.a: rubber · sheath · external condom · internal condom · female condom
kinds.d: Thin sheath worn on the penis or inside the vagina as a contraceptive and barrier against infection.
Single-dose pill taken soon after unprotected sex to lower the chance of pregnancy.
Thin latex or polyurethane sheet placed over the genitals or anus as a barrier during oral sex.
Topical anaesthetic spray applied to the penis to reduce sensitivity and delay ejaculation.
